<!-- Generated by genclidocs from the cobra command tree in client/cmd. Do not edit. -->

Manages the local principal mapping (JSON object: account → []string of principals). Used by `host principals` to answer sshd's AuthorizedPrincipalsCommand.

## Synopsis

```
ssoossh host mapping [command] [flags]
```

## Global options

Inherited from [`ssoossh`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/) and its parents.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-c`, `--config` | string |  | path to the ssoossh config file |
| `--file` | string | `/etc/ssoossh/principals.json` | path to the local principal mapping file (JSON object: local account -&gt; list of principals) |
| `--server` | string |  | server address including scheme (e.g. "https://example.com") assumes https if omited. |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | count | `0` | trace what the command is doing, to stderr; repeat for more (-v steps, -vv requests and files, -vvv bodies) |

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`ssoossh host mapping add`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/host-mapping-add/) | Add a principal to an account's mapping. |
| [`ssoossh host mapping list`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/host-mapping-list/) | Print the current principal mapping. |
| [`ssoossh host mapping remove`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/host-mapping-remove/) | Remove a principal or an entire account mapping. |
